Plan

AI Plan Reader

Upload a plan set as PDF, CAD or phone photos. The Plan Reader reads each sheet for dimensions, rooms and schedules, then cross-checks the set: sheets dated differently, blank revision blocks, a fireplace on the plan with no chimney on the elevation.

  • Flags can be turned into RFIs.
  • Sheets that cannot be read are marked, not guessed.
  • An estimator verifies the numbers before they feed the takeoff.
Plan

Measure without a laser

On a Pro iPhone or iPad, the LiDAR sensor scans each room. On any other phone, take a photo with the printed scale card on the wall. Either way, tape one wall to check the scan.

  • If the tape and the scan differ by more than the tolerance, the room is flagged for a new scan.
  • Ordering and structural use wait until the room passes.
  • Measured rooms feed the floor plan.
Pro iPhone, iPadLiDAR room scan
Other phonesPhoto plus scale card
Every phoneTape check on one wall
Plan

Floor plans, 3D and construction sheets

Draw walls, rooms, doors and windows with dimensions. The 3D model builds from the plan. Layers for HVAC, plumbing and electrical sit on the same plan.

  • Sheets for A, M, P, E and S with title blocks and schedules.
  • Print at 24 by 36 or 11 by 17, or save as PDF.
  • Sheets can carry a preliminary stamp until a licensed professional seals them.

Sheet M2.01 as it prints, with title block and preliminary stamp.

Estimate

Whole-house takeoff and cost forecasts

The whole house, from a screw to the roof. Each line traces back to a zone on a color-coded markup, so anyone on the team can see what was counted and what was left out.

  • Markup PDFs color-coded by zone.
  • Export to Excel for suppliers.
  • Material cost forecast at 6, 9 and 12 months, and a 14 month worst case.
  • Marked AI-built and estimator-verified, with who verified it and when.
Decide

Deal Analyzer

For new builds, flips, remodels, additions and build-to-rent. Pull comps to set the ARV, see the area trend score, and get profit, max offer and risk flags with a GO or NO-GO and the reason behind it.

  • Profit at 6, 9 and 12 months, and at a 14 month worst case.
  • Finish packages feed straight into the deal, so an upgrade shows its effect on margin.

Try the free deal calculator for a quick version of the math.

Decide

Structure check and ways to make it bigger

Before you promise a client an open kitchen or a second story, check the foundation, framing and rafters. Each check comes back pass or fail.

  • Expansion options show how to make the house bigger, each with a zoning check.

Preliminary only. A Texas licensed professional engineer must design and seal the structure.

Decide

Site checks

Look up the parcel number, check the house against setbacks, height and lot coverage, see which way it faces and how many hours of sun the yard gets through the year.

  • Zoning clearance check against district rules.
  • Sun hours for the rear yard through the day, on key dates of the year.
  • Confirm against the adopted code before you submit.
Decide

Finish selections in 3D

Show the client countertops, cabinets, sinks, faucets, flooring, backsplash, paint and lighting in a 3D room, with Good, Better and Best prices side by side. The client approves in the app and the selection locks.

  • Installed prices per option, by room.
  • Approved selections flow into the takeoff and the deal.
Build

Permits, insurance, POs and the schedule

Every project tracks its permits, licenses and certificates of insurance. Hard gates mean a purchase order cannot release until the permit is issued and the vendor certificate is current. An admin override is there for the exceptions.

  • POs to vendors with start notices.
  • Calendar with late and running-behind alerts.
  • A dashboard ordered by consequence: what is blocking work comes first.
Build

Daily logs, punch lists, job costing and closeout

Daily logs, punch lists, job costing and closeout live on the same project as the plans and the estimate, so the field and the office look at the same job.
